title: Unit receivable advancement processed successfully
description: Outcome of a Tangara post-contracted advancement batch whose operations and advanced unit receivables were all processed. The event is strictly informative: it does not settle, consume free balance or change the status of the unit receivables. One event is emitted per batch, correlated by the cid of the envelope. Produced by ur-api, the Tangara unit receivable service.
